meta.title: FitStream AI - AI-Powered Fitness & Nutrition Companion
meta.description: Track workouts with AI pose detection, scan food for calories, manage your kitchen inventory, and get personalized coaching. Available on iOS, Android, and Web.

hero.description: Track workouts, scan food for calories, read your scale with AI, and get personalized motivation — all in one beautiful app.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: Powerful features to transform your fitness journey

poseTracking.title: AI Pose Tracking
poseTracking.description: Real-time form analysis using MediaPipe. Get instant feedback on your exercise technique without any cloud processing.
poseTracking.short: Real-time form analysis with MediaPipe. 15 exercises with instant feedback.

smartKitchen.title: Smart Kitchen
smartKitchen.description: Manage your fridge, pantry & freezer inventory. AI recognizes products from photos. Get recipe suggestions based on what you have.
smartKitchen.short: Manage fridge, pantry & freezer. AI recognizes products from photos.

cookingMode.title: Guided Cooking
cookingMode.description: Step-by-step instructions with integrated timers, stir/flip reminders, and troubleshooting tips. Log calories when done.
cookingMode.short: Step-by-step recipes with timers, reminders & troubleshooting tips.

nutritionScanner.title: AI Food Scanner
nutritionScanner.description: Take a photo of your meal and get instant calorie estimation. Uses a reference object for accurate portion sizing.
nutritionScanner.short: Snap a photo for instant calorie and macro estimates.

smartScale.title: Smart Scale
smartScale.description: Connect Xiaomi Mi Scale via Bluetooth or point your camera at any scale — AI reads automatically.
smartScale.short: Point your camera at any scale — AI reads automatically.

healthIntegrations.title: Health Sync
healthIntegrations.description: Seamlessly sync with Google Fit, Apple Health, and Samsung Health. Your data flows automatically between platforms.
healthIntegrations.short: Seamless sync with Google Fit, Apple Health & Samsung Health.

exercises.title: 15 Exercises
exercises.description: Squats, Push-ups, Sit-ups, Lunges, Burpees, Jumping Jacks, High Knees, Mountain Climbers, Plank, Wall Sit, Leg Raises, Glute Bridges, Calf Raises, Side Lunges, Tricep Dips
exercises.short: Track 15 different exercises with automatic rep counting.

offlineFirst.title: Offline First
offlineFirst.description: Full functionality without internet. Your data syncs automatically when you're back online.
offlineFirst.short: Works without internet — syncs when back online.

multiLanguage.title: 6 Languages
multiLanguage.description: English, Русский, Español, Français, Deutsch, 中文. Auto-detects your browser language.

multiPlatform.title: Multi-Platform
multiPlatform.description: Web, iOS, Android, and Telegram Mini App. One account, all your devices.
multiPlatform.short: Web, iOS, Android, and Telegram. One account everywhere.

aiCoach.title: AI Coach
aiCoach.description: Personalized motivational quotes and tips powered by Gemini AI. Choose male (Fenrir) or female (Kore) voice.

smartShopping.title: Shopping Assistant
smartShopping.description: Plan meals, generate shopping lists, verify products by photo, scan store shelves to find what you need.
smartShopping.short: AI plans meals and creates smart shopping lists.

foodFinance.title: Food Finance
foodFinance.description: Track your food spending, see where your money goes, and calculate savings from home cooking vs eating out.
foodFinance.short: Track food spending. Calculate savings from home cooking.

receiptScanning.title: Receipt Scanning
receiptScanning.description: Scan grocery receipts to automatically add products to your kitchen inventory with prices and expiry dates.
receiptScanning.short: Scan receipts to auto-add products with prices & expiry dates.

gamification.title: Achievements
gamification.description: Earn achievements for hitting milestones. Compete with friends on the social leaderboard.
gamification.short: Earn achievements. Compete on the leaderboard.

charts.title: Analytics
charts.description: Visualize your progress with beautiful charts. Track trends in weight, calories, workouts, and body composition.

ai.description: Our AI doesn't just count — it sees, understands, and adapts to your unique fitness journey.
ai.visionDesc: Reads scales, identifies food, analyzes menus
ai.portionDesc: Uses reference objects for accurate portions
ai.motivationDesc: AI adapts encouragement to your progress

pricing.title: Simple Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you're ready

download.description: Download FitStream now and start your AI-powered fitness journey
